title: R6 scale summaries retention archive and capability truth closure
businessRules: R6 is limited to F26 capability truth, F27 daily summary materialization, F28 retention/archive runtime, F29 ExternalMapping secondary closure, and F30 AccountingCloseControl canonical truth from the master recovery workflow.
Operator assistant remains deterministic, source-linked, permission scoped, read-only, and must not claim external AI/LLM provider capability.
Daily summaries are rebuilt idempotently per authenticated branch and UTC business date from completed Sale and canonical journal lines.

Retention/archive policy is tenant-scoped; archive execution is fail-closed unless an explicit storage provider is configured. This wave supports local durable-volume archives for CI/self-hosted use and records SHA-256 checksum.
Archive execution does not delete source rows. Destructive purge remains separate and must never occur before successful archive evidence and an explicit policy.
ExternalMapping is tenant-authorized through IntegrationConnection and marketplace import materializes the mapping contract automatically.
AccountingCloseControl remains the canonical posting lock already proven by R4 exact-runtime evidence.
F26-F29 are HIGH/runtime-evidence findings and remain VERIFICATION until exact-source PostgreSQL R6 probe passes. Human Stage-20 remains separate.
acceptanceCriteria: F26 Admin labels and API response state deterministic rule-based capability with aiProvider=null and no LLM claim.
F27 API materializes and reads DailySalesSummary and DailyFinanceSummary for authenticated branch with audit evidence.
F28 operator/API can manage retention policy and execute checksum-bound archive artifact lifecycle with fail-closed provider configuration.
F29 ExternalMapping list/upsert/delete lifecycle exists and marketplace import automatically creates/updates a mapping.
F30 documentation/matrix reflects AccountingCloseControl canonical runtime use already proven by R4 close/reopen/posting probe.
Both GitHub PostgreSQL workflows run ci:r6:probe and aggregate evidence requires R6 PASS.
Focused R6 test, workflow validation, repo validation, recovery audit, API lint/Prisma generate, and dependency-free regression pass before push.
testPlan: GitHub ci:r6:probe on exact PostgreSQL runtime
migrationPlan: No schema migration. Existing Daily*Summary, DataRetentionPolicy, DataArchiveRun, ExternalMapping, and AccountingCloseControl models are reused.
rollbackPlan: Revert R6 API/UI/probe wave atomically. Archive files are additive evidence and source rows are never deleted by this wave.
monitoringPlan: R6 GitHub evidence records exact source fingerprint plus summary, archive, mapping, capability-truth, and AccountingCloseControl checks.
securityNotes: Tenant scope derives from JWT context; archive allowlist is restricted to tenant-owned entities and local archive provider is explicit/fail-closed.
releaseEvidence: ci:r6:probe PASS on exact PostgreSQL runtime
Stage-20 automated PASS after diagnostic correction
Human Stage-20 remains PENDING 12/12 and separate
